pull_request.title: Calorimeter: Si-W service, HCAL routing and forward envelopes
pull_request.head: codex/layout001-service-envelopes
pull_request.body:
LAYOUT-001 currently has local Si-W cooling/electronics but no external service allocation. This prototype retains PR #70/#71 ECAL packages and placements, adds a 300 mm circular backbone outside the polygon corners, and enlarges the HCAL outline with a 400 mm rear break for radial egress.

The allocation budgets data/power/HV/water stations and ordinary/merged nominal and adverse cable footprints. It adds an empty future FCal reservation at R=0.080-0.290 m, |z|=4.5332-6.3791 m. The layout main page and R-Z drawing show these interfaces; PR #75 will summarize both candidates with the same text as its four-page PDF.

![Updated LAYOUT-001 R-Z envelope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/layout001-service-envelopes/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.png)

[DES034](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/layout001-service-envelopes/docs/design/DES-034-siw-service-envelopes.md) and the retained allocation report distinguish source facts, new choices and unresolved engineering. Local collector/port connections, full junction routing, hydraulic/thermal/load qualification and forward hardware remain open. These are empty-envelope allocations; no production detector, native combined geometry, acceptance or magnetic solution is claimed.

Validation: ten tests (eight physical negative controls plus two nominal cases), retained report/layout/SVG reproduction, eleven primary-source hash checks and visual drawing inspection pass. Separate frozen-source SysArch input and PhysVal assessment are recorded; feed-loop/count findings were corrected and closed. The new allocation/replay/drawing step also passed on Linux; broad inherited CI is running. No new externals.

events.text:
**SIW-SERVICE-PhysVal-review** assessed `78cfa3fe8ac56e4b48a11870ca2758bdae25ed6c` read-only. Two findings:

- **P2 — feed copper and electrical losses use different endcap lengths.** [study.py:76]([redacted] counts four conductors at **12 m each**, giving a **24 m supply-plus-return route** and **172.032 kg Cu/endcap**. Resistance at line 67 uses **40 m** for those same feeds. Consequently, [DES034:106]([redacted] combines inconsistent nominal cases. Four conductors matching the 40 m electrical loop require **286.720 kg/endcap**, making the total **1.146880 t**, rather than **0.917504 t**. Reconcile the lengths or explicitly separate the inventory and electrical scenarios. Envelope packing is unaffected.
- **P3 — negative-control count is overstated.** [DES034:144]([redacted] says eight negative controls. The suite contains **seven negative controls plus one nominal test**.

Actual checks:

- **Eight pinned standard-library tests passed.**
- Retained allocation output reproduces exactly; input/producer hashes and **all 11 primary-source bindings match**.
- Native interface counts correctly distinguish powered chips from passive PCBs.
- Independently checked continuous single-elbow bounds: swept radius remains below **2500.129 mm** while beside HCAL, and maximum swept z is **4728.2 mm**, below HCAL front **4883.2 mm**.
- Packing, circular/polygon clearances, HCAL dimensions/volume, heat/flow and FCal accommodation arithmetic otherwise agree.

The proposal consistently labels reservations as empty and retains missing collectors, connections, supports, hydraulics, bandwidth, installed material, field and acceptance qualification. No native construction or η4 acceptance is implied.

No edits, native jobs, installs or sign-off. Dirty journal/drawing content was excluded; earlier LAr contribution remains disclosed.

events.text:
SIW-SERVICE-SysArch-input completed at **62b8b35765ff55163c504e3d551f4366a536948b**. No files changed, new packages, native jobs or sign-off.

The proposed outer backbone and rear HCAL break are credible **space allocations** while preserving PR70/71 ECAL packages and placements. Physical cassette collectors and penetrations remain unresolved, as they do for the LAr prototype.

**Source-count reconciliation**

The native `interface` role counts include passive shared PCBs:

- Barrel: **22,560 = 15,648 powered interface chips + 6,912 shared PCBs**. There is one PCB per slab/layer/sector: 9×48×16.
- Both endcaps: **6,144 = 4,608 powered interface chips + 1,536 shared PCBs**. Each wedge/layer has one PCB and three interface chips.

Thus 15,648 barrel interfaces and 2,304 per endcap govern the recorded interface-power hypothesis and external link allocation. Using the larger native role counts as independently powered units would double-count passive PCBs.

Exact primary locators:

- PR71 revision `2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217`, `tools/calorimeter_hardware/barrel_export.py:60–63`; `barrel_layout.py:58–73`; `docs/validation/DES-031/native.json`, `physical_counts`.
- PR70 revision `654b85a48abeb38735ad7fe0866c5d1082882df7`, `tools/calorimeter_hardware/edge_export.py:70–76`; `edge_layout.py:218–220`; `docs/validation/DES-030/native-edges.json`, `physical_counts`.

**External station and packing proposal**

These are **unsigned NODD DESIGN CHOICES**, following the existing LAr allocation conventions rather than selected Si-W cable hardware:

| Quantity | Barrel | Each endcap |
|---|---:|---:|
| Stations | 32: 16 sectors × 2 ends | 16: one per wedge |
| Powered interfaces/station, balanced average | 489 | 144 |
| 2.5 mm data-pair cables/station | 1,956 | 576 |
| 2 mm fibres/station | 1,956 | 576 |
| 3 mm HV cables/station | 12 | 20 |
| Power/ground/control cables/station | 4×12 / 2×8 / 4×3 mm | Same |
| Supply/return water jackets/station | 2×50 mm OD | Same |
| Nominal packed area, 40% fill | 50,849 mm² | 23,216 mm² |
| Adverse area: double data/fibres, 30% fill | 120,286 mm² | 46,412 mm² |

Four data pairs and four fibres per interface are deliberately conservative routing hypotheses, not a qualified bandwidth architecture. The balanced barrel station assignment and local collector graph are not yet demonstrated.

A **700×150 mm** lane fits nominal loads but fails the barrel adverse scenario. A **900×150 mm** lane fits each subsystem separately. At each rear junction the combined barrel/endcap nominal area is **74,065 mm²**, and adverse area **166,698 mm²**. Reserve a **900×220 mm junction envelope**, centred at **R=2.430 m**, to contain both:

- inner radial face: 2.320 m;
- far corner: √(2.540²+0.450²) = **2.5796 m**;
- maximum angular extent: atan(0.450/2.320) = **10.98°**, below the 11.25° half-sector;
- capacity: **198,000 mm²**, with approximately 20 mm clearance to each circular backbone boundary.

This checks footprint containment, not installed packing, connector access or a complete bend network.

Using the LAr-style 20 m/barrel-station and 12 m/endcap-station route hypotheses gives:

| Cable length | Barrel | Each endcap |
|---|---:|---:|
| Data pairs / fibres | 1,251.840 / 1,251.840 km | 110.592 / 110.592 km |
| HV | 7.680 km | 3.840 km |
| Power / ground / control | 2.560 / 1.280 / 2.560 km | 0.768 / 0.384 / 0.768 km |
| Water jackets, supply + return | 1.280 km | 0.384 km |

These large Si-W link lengths expose the cost of exporting every existing interface without further aggregation. Optical-only backbones or local multiplexing are alternatives requiring electronics, heat and bandwidth assessment. Retain ±50% route-length uncertainty; these sums include routes outside the detector handoff and are not installed mass.

**Cooling and electrical input**

Reproducing the pinned formulas gives:

- Barrel heat: **188.401475 kW**.
- Each endcap: **35.525470 kW**.
- Total: **259.452415 kW**.
- Ideal water at 4,180 J/(kg·K), ΔT=5 K: **12.413991 kg/s**.
- Per station: barrel **0.281701 kg/s**, endcap **0.106236 kg/s**.

A chosen **20 mm water bore inside the 50 mm external jacket** gives nominal bulk velocities of **0.897 / 0.338 m/s**. A 1.5× load scenario requires **18.621 kg/s total**, before hydraulic/thermal qualification.

The source heat formula already includes 90%-efficient conversion; do **not** divide it by 0.9 again. A new 48 V upstream feed hypothesis gives **122.66 / 46.26 A per barrel/endcap station**. With two parallel 25 mm² Cu conductors per polarity, a 40 m supply-plus-return loop and ρ=1.72×10⁻⁸ Ωm:

- nominal drops: **1.688 / 0.636 V**;
- nominal external losses: **207.0 / 29.4 W per station**;
- 1.5× load drops: **2.532 / 0.955 V**;
- aggregate nominal external cable loss: **7.57 kW**, additional to the recorded local ECAL heat.

Ampacity, converter placement, voltage drop at temperature and removal of external cable heat are unqualified.

There are **51,552 local coolant runs and 103,104 endpoints** across the ECAL. Hierarchical collectors are essential. The proposed backbone does not connect those endpoints automatically.

**HCAL amendments**

Retain the ECAL packages and original **1.4959 m HCAL sampling/cover depth**:

| Allocation | Proposed value |
|---|---:|
| Circular service backbone | R=2.300–2.600 m |
| HCAL barrel inner / outer apothems | 2.600 / 4.0959 m |
| HCAL barrel half-length | 4.4832 m |
| Rear barrel/endcap break | 0.400 m |
| HCAL endcap front / back | |z|=4.8832 / 6.3791 m |
| HCAL endcap inner / outer apothems | 0.300 / 4.0859 m |

The retained barrel package's maximum corner radius is **2.276951 m**, leaving **23.049 mm** to the circular backbone. The endcap corner radius is **2.266755 m**. HCAL barrel corners reach **4.176143 m**.

Routes travel axially outside ECAL, then radially through the rear break and out beyond the HCAL corner, avoiding drilled active HCAL. A 50 mm jacket with a chosen 4×OD bend radius needs **245 mm** axial allocation for one 90° turn, including half-OD and 20 mm clearance. The 400 mm break supports this individual-pipe check; it does **not** establish a two-elbow S-bend or full junction engineering. Use an external pipe-centre handoff around **R≥4.23 m**.

The unchanged **30 mm front barrel/endcap seam remains installation-only**, with no qualified route through it. Local Si-W service allowances contain tungsten/aluminium, and tube ends stop 5 mm inside plates. Cassette-side collection ports, header attachments, load paths and local clearances remain missing.

HCAL outline volume rises **×1.241** relative to the pinned LAYOUT-001: barrel 224.783→285.832 m³, each endcap 66.489→79.052 m³. These are envelope/load indicators, not installed mass or a magnetic solution.

**Forward reservation**

Do not copy LAr's upstream collar at |z|4.40–4.85 m: it intersects the retained Si-W endcap through 4.4832 m.

A simple non-overlapping alternative is an **empty FCal reservation**:

- R=0.080–0.290 m;
- |z|=4.5332–6.3791 m;
- 50 mm behind ECAL;
- 10 mm inside HCAL's minimum circular aperture, set by its 0.300 m inner apothem.

An η=4 IP ray has radii **166.11 / 233.75 mm** at its front/back. This is a reservation fit check, not acceptance or containment.

If a wider prospective collar is desired, split the allocation without overlap:

- rear collar: R=0.080–0.450 m, |z|4.5332–4.8332 m;
- narrow FCal: R=0.080–0.290 m, |z|4.8332–6.3791 m.

Technology, beam pipe beyond its current 4 m end, shielding, supports, services and shower depth remain unresolved. No forward target beyond the existing prototype exploration is selected.
